scientific_integrity: Proof and derivation are self-contained; independent exhaustive finite comparisons reproduce local and global counts. Source dates and published qualitative results are credited rather than reasserted as new.
scientific_limitations: The target has at least two positive labelled arms. Maps are surjective and bounded, arm lengths are fixed in the asymptotic regime. The random model is uniform on locally admissible maps. Classical occupancy limits are not claimed as new. Independent external validation has not occurred; other older formulations could cover parts of the result.
title: Exact bounded-morphism multiplicities and a sharp root-gluing window for starlike Kripke frames
